bio.text: Lisa Kinney is the Democratic candidate for Wyoming's U.S. House seat in 2026.
Kinney's WyoFile election guide response says the candidate was born in Laramie and has lived there since birth.
The response says Kinney spent 10 years in the Wyoming State Senate, two of them as Minority Leader, and served on the Education and Judiciary committees.
The response describes Kinney as a former librarian, attorney and financial advisor.
